segmentName: Press Brake, CNC & Fiber Laser Machines

market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Global press brake machine market: $667.5M (2024) to $1,055.89M by 2032 (5.9%/yr) per one source; $668.54M (2024) to $936.16M by 2030 (5.77%/yr) per another; a third source cites $5.22B (2023) growing at 4.8%/yr through 2030 — wide variance across vendors. Global press brakes (2025-2035 outlook): $0.79B (2025) to $1.40B by 2035 (5.9%/yr). Global fiber laser cutting machine market: $1,954.2M (2024) per one source, or $2,594.57M (2024) to $3,875.58M by 2031 (5.90%/yr) per another. India fiber laser cutting machine market: $53.94M (2024), 9.3%/yr — India cited as likely to dominate Asia-Pacific laser-cutting-machine growth at ~9.2%/yr through 2032. India hydraulic press market (adjacent category): $546.04M (2024) to $846.51M by 2033.
market.domesticSlice: Asia-Pacific holds ~45% of the global press-brake market share (large manufacturing base, rapid CNC integration); Europe ~30%. Amada India and BendTech Engineers are named in-market competitors; a specific India-only press-brake market-size figure in ₹ crore was not found.

structureFacts: Government 'Make in India' initiatives and MSME modernization are cited as drivers of CNC press-brake adoption over conventional models in India
Industry 4.0/automation adoption is a generically cited driver across multiple reports, without India-specific adoption-rate statistics found
Amada/Trumpf/Bystronic operate at a vastly larger global scale than typical Indian manufacturers in this space — useful as technology/competitive benchmarks, not scale peers

adoptionStructure.note: Precision, faster output, and automation-driven reduction in operator error in high-volume metalworking cycles drive adoption; shift toward CNC/hybrid machines for greater precision and automation versus manual/conventional press brakes.
